name: Linda McMahon

lean.basis: Republican nominee for U.S. Senate in Connecticut in 2010 and 2012, major Republican donor, and Trump cabinet member in both terms.

sources.title: Ballotpedia: Connecticut Senate elections, 2012
Education Week: Trump picks Linda McMahon

source.title: File:ED Sec Linda McMahon (cropped).jpg — Wikimedia Commons

summary: Linda McMahon built World Wrestling Entertainment with her husband Vince McMahon and served as its CEO, then spent more than $100 million of her own money on two losing Republican Senate campaigns in Connecticut (2010, 2012). She ran the Small Business Administration in Trump's first term (2017–2019), chaired the America First Policy Institute, co-chaired Trump's 2024 transition with Howard Lutnick, and has been education secretary since March 2025.
